text:
This guidance is for employers and other organisations who are applying for, or already hold, a sponsor licence on the Worker or Temporary Worker routes. It contains definitions of terms and phrases commonly used in the ‘Workers and Temporary Workers: guidance for sponsors’ document collection.

We are aware this publication may have accessibility issues, for example if you use assistive technology.

Contact us if you need this document in a different format.

We cannot answer any other questions through this form.

Read our accessible documents policy.
